title: Yield prediction and condition recommendation on high-throughput experimentation datasets
description:
Code and result tables for a thirteen-dataset audit of yield prediction on high-throughput experimentation data: categorical encoding effects, noise ceilings and capture ratios, attribution stability across architectures, and the behaviour of acquisition functions relative to ranking.

Raw datasets are not redistributed: run fetch_datasets.bat to download and prepare them from the public sources listed in the article's data availability statement.
